# mimecast_account_packages (Data Source)

Read the provisioned Mimecast product/package inventory.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_account_packages" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable package inventory ID.
